pressure_rule: True only when event.under_pressure is explicitly true; absent/null/false means not flagged, not verified absence of defensive pressure. Reject unexpected nonboolean values.
pressure_model: Within each training fold, smooth each origin/flag group toward that fold's smoothed origin probability: (group completions + 20 * origin probability) / (group attempts + 20).
validation: Same five whole-match folds and eligible labels as lesson 48. Refit every count/prior in the training fold; retain all outcomes and sample IDs.
primary_metric: Pooled out-of-fold log loss; compare pressure model with origin-only model
interpretation: Exploratory feature experiment on already inspected development matches, not fresh evaluation or causal pressure effects. No tuning based on results.
